summary: Lincoln County, WI 84-foot DNR standard stair tower built 1932; NHLR US 1243 (2017); listed as gone, and a DNR tower there was toppled in 1971 per a 1972 report.

facts.design: 84-foot Wisconsin standard stair-style tower with galvanized steel plate landings and treads
facts.status_note: Listed as gone by the Forest Fire Lookout Association; a June 1972 newspaper report describes a DNR tower toppled in 1971, but the 2017 NHLR entry uses the present tense and the sources do not show which tower is which

events.note: A DNR fire tower on Lookout Mountain was toppled on November 5 of the fall before a June 10, 1972 report; the year 1971 is inferred from 'last fall' in that report
In June 1972 a Lincoln County judge found the man charged with the toppling innocent by reason of insanity

evidence.supports: 84-foot Wisconsin standard tower with stairs rather than a cage-protected external ladder
evidence.quote: This 84-foot Wisconsin standard tower features stairs rather than the much more common cage-protected external ladder typically found on this type of tower.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The FFLOS list marks the tower gone, and the 1972 report describes a DNR tower toppled in 1971, so the record uses gone. The 2017 NHLR entry is written in the present tense; the sources do not show whether it describes the toppled tower or the second tower that was targeted, so this stays open in status_note.

sources.title: Lookout Mountain, Forest Lookouts
sources.publisher: Forest Lookouts (reprints The Milwaukee Sentinel, June 10, 1972)

notes_for_editor: The 1971 date is inferred from 'last fall' in a June 10, 1972 report reproduced second-hand on centraluslookouts; no primary copy of the Sentinel was read. The story does not name the man charged. Unresolved: whether the NHLR-described tower is the one toppled or the second tower that was targeted. The FFLOS detail page is not in the crawl cache. The name 'Searchlight' in the FFLOS listing is unexplained and is not used.
